title: Your first route
summary: Answer a browser request with app.get and res.send.

quiz.q: Which method does a browser use when you type an address and press Enter?
quiz.explain: Typing an address makes the browser ask for a page with GET.

quiz.q: Complete the route so it answers requests for the home page.
quiz.explain: `app.get` registers a GET route and `res.send` sends the answer.

quiz.q: In `(req, res) => { ... }`, which one do you use to send the answer?
quiz.explain: `res` is the response. `req` is the request that came in.

exercise.task:
In `app.js`, add a GET route for `/` that sends the text `Hello from Express`.

Leave `module.exports = app;` at the bottom.
hints: Use `app.get('/', ...)` and give it a function with `req` and `res`.
Inside the function call `res.send(...)` with the text in quotes.
